The '''Imperial Elite Guard''' were elite highly-trained [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] assigned by the revived [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|protective detail]] for both the [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial Head of State]] and important [[Moff/Legends|government officials]] as personal [[bodyguard]]s. Due to their unique status within the revitalized Imperial Remnant, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the Guard were distinguished from the rest of their fellow [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] in the re-established [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] by [[gray]] stripes on the shoulder pads of their [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] collapsed, and with the Empire later [[Imperial Reunification|reconstituting]] itself into a handful of backwater [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. As the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] strengthened its control over the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], [[Head of State/Legends|Imperial Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] sought to build a sufficient amount of order and stability so that the Remnant would survive long after his death. In addition to the many actions he took in pursuit of this goal, a new [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[unit]] of [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] was created to protect the highest ranking officials in the Remnant. This special detachment of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was known as the Imperial Elite Guard; its [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were aesthetically separated from the rest of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] by the [[gray]] markings on the shoulder pads of their [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Revelation" />

[[41 ABY|A year]] after the outbreak of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Galactic Alliance faced an increasingly dire situation against the rebellion of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and its [[Confederation|Confederate allies]]. [[Darth Caedus]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Caedus|Joint Chief of State]] of the Galactic Alliance, was eager to add the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|strength]] of the Imperial Remnant to the Alliance's overstretched [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|military forces]]. Caedus was also impressed by the [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] of the Imperial Elite Guard and their reputation as an equal match to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. By this time, the Elite Guard was stationed in [[Ravelin]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Revelation" />

After Pellaeon reluctantly agreed to help the Alliance in its objective to destroy the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-led insurgency, a combined [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of Alliance and Imperial [[Warship/Legends|warships]] converged on the secessionist world of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. A unit of the Imperial Elite Guard accompanied Pellaeon and several high ranking members of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] on the Head of State's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']]. However, shortly after the [[Second Battle of Fondor|battle]] commenced, the Galactic Alliance became divided after [[Cha Niathal|Joint Chief of State]] [[Cha Niathal]] betrayed Darth Caedus by accepting the [[Fondorian]]s' surrender while her colleague was preoccupied with leading the attack. Though the vast majority of the Alliance fleet declared its allegiance to Caedus, Pellaeon's personal vendetta against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] influenced his decision to support Niathal's backdoor deal with Fondor. As a consequence, Pellaeon was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]]. With the Head of State out of the way, the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] redirected Remnant forces to support Caedus and the true Galactic Alliance against Niathal's [[Alliance-in-exile|faction]]. Unfortunately for Veila and the Moffs, much of the ''Bloodfin's'' personnel were loyal to Pellaeon, and thus the Elite Guard found itself in a desperate fight to the death with mutineers. Although the Guard failed to prevent the deaths of the Moffs, their actions created a distraction that allowed Caedus to infiltrate the ''Bloodfin'' and rescue Veila, whom he anointed as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Revelation" />

In the aftermath of the debacle at Fondor, the remaining members of the Moff Council secured their hold over the Imperial Remnant. At the same time, the shock troopers of the Imperial Elite Guard served as protection detail for the Moffs. As such, they accompanied them to the [[Battle of Roche]] and also participated in the [[Battle of Uroro Station]]. Under the command of Tahiri Veila, a special detachment of the Elite Guard attempted to destroy the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|secret base]] on [[Shedu Maad]]. However, they were forced to create a distraction against several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opponents while Veila proceeded to complete the mission.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

Yet their efforts were in vain. Shortly afterward, a disillusioned Tahiri Veila renounced her allegiance to the [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]] and was taken into Jedi custody. Meanwhile, Darth Caedus was [[Duel on the Anakin Solo|killed]] by his twin sister, the Jedi [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. With Caedus' death and the surrender of the Moffs, the Galactic Alliance and the Imperial Remnant fell under the temporary control of the [[Jedi Coalition]]. By the end of the war, the Galactic Alliance remained as the dominant force in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and the Imperial Remnant was placed under the leadership of [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="Invincible" />
